name: zmodel_matlbuffer_read_gamez
description: zModel_MatlBuffer::ReadGameZ loads the material-pool header and slot array, expands the pool as needed, restores serialized texture references, packs color materials, and reads cycle frame tables.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass.

Binary Ninja still records a limited reconstruction marker because HLIL does not fully simplify the shared error tail and active-list slot stride despite typed overlays; assembly and targeted smoke coverage support tier C equivalence.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4808c0 validates the four 32-bit header reads, zero-capacity return, malloc/realloc pool sizing with 0x2c-byte material slots, slot-array fread, active-list traversal, textured-material index restoration through zImage::TexIndexToDirEntry, non-textured packed-color conversion through zVid::PackColorRgbFloats, cycle/frame-table allocation and reads, frame index restoration, and -1 failure returns through zError::ReportOldNoOp.

The native material read smoke verifies pool expansion, loaded header globals, active-list material conversion for color and texture cases, cycle allocation, and cycle frame-table index-to-pointer restoration.
